baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative construction fa-ayna plus second-person plural tadhhabuna, anchored in the departure branch of ذ ه ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does not neutrally request a destination. The initial fa presents movement as a consequence already underway, while ayna forces the moving group to disclose the endpoint of its present trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Going, passing, or departure supplies the literal motion and makes the interrogative diagnose an already active trajectory.

changed_reading.before: A neutral question asking for the hearers' destination.
changed_reading.after: A confrontational diagnosis: given what precedes the fa, what endpoint is your ongoing departure actually producing?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's madhhab branch makes ذ ه ب available as a route, place, time, or manner, while ayna demands orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Destination and method coexist. The question can press not only for where the hearers will arrive, but for the way, stance, or manner they are adopting in order to get there.

activation_trace.role: A route, place, time, or manner supplies the literal path-image and turns destination into an adopted method of orientation.

changed_reading.after: What way or manner are you making into your operative path?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory includes a branch of dazzlement or fright on seeing gold, and ayna can test lost orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The motion may register a perceptual event as well as deliberate travel: someone dazzled or startled no longer knows where perception is carrying them. The question can therefore expose disorientation rather than merely request coordinates.

activation_trace.role: Dazzlement or fright upon seeing precious brilliance supplies a literal loss of composure and makes 'where' a test of perceptual orientation.

changed_reading.before: The hearers knowingly choose a route.
changed_reading.after: The hearers may be so dazzled or startled that the question asks where their disturbed perception is carrying them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early sequence rolls up, scatters, displaces, and strips the very bodies that ordinarily stabilize orientation. Against that dismantled coordinate system, the focus question no longer asks the hearers to choose a point on an intact map; it asks what basis for direction survives when the map itself is being unmade.

activation_trace.role: The route or place branch supplies the coordinate-dependent path whose basis the context removes.
Turning and folding a thing into itself supplies the loss of the sun's extended orienting surface.
Scattered plunging motion supplies the dispersal of stellar markers and breaks a stable sky-map.
Displacement and removal make the normally fixed mountains mobile, depriving travel of terrestrial landmarks.
Removing a cover and exposing what was hidden strips away the enclosing surface within which ordinary directions made sense.

structural_cues: The repeated passive idha clauses move fixed cosmic and terrestrial objects before the active second-person plural movement of 81:26.
The focus interrogative shifts agency onto the hearers only after their presumed coordinate system has been dismantled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies folded, scattered, displaced, and stripped landmarks plus the focus path-image. I infer that loss of landmarks changes a destination question into a question about the ground of orientation. A live alternative is that the sequence only intensifies an otherwise ordinary rebuke by spectacle.

changed_reading.before: Choose and name your destination within a stable world.
changed_reading.after: What can your direction even mean when the sun, stars, mountains, and sky that framed direction are no longer stable?

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual motion converges rather than disperses: groups are driven toward an objective, like is joined to like, and an end is pushed near. The plural 'you go' can therefore describe self-sorting into a company and destination, not solitary escape into open space.

activation_trace.role: Departure supplies the hearers' motion, which the context redirects from private flight toward convergence.
Driving and gathering a group toward an objective supplies a destination that collects rather than releases movers.
Likenesses and companions grouped by form or deed supply the social classification produced by the journey.
An impulse toward nearness supplies directed convergence and makes the endpoint approach the travelers.

structural_cues: Passive gathering and pairing precede the active plural address, so the group that thinks it is choosing a route may already be sorting itself.
The focus uses a plural subject, preserving a social rather than merely individual destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering toward an objective, grouping by likeness or deed, and driven nearness. I infer that present choices classify the travelers into the company toward which they converge. A live alternative is that these are only final-state images and do not describe the hearers' current social alignment.

changed_reading.before: Each hearer may depart independently toward any chosen place.
changed_reading.after: Toward what gathering, and into the company of which likeness and deeds, is your shared movement sorting you?

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier question opens a case, names alleged guilt and killing, spreads written records, and brings deeds into presence. The later 'where' can function as the next examination question: spatial departure becomes an attempted evasion when evidence and consequences have already been made present.

activation_trace.role: Going away supplies the attempted exit that the forensic sequence converts into evasion.
Reciprocal questioning supplies an examination frame that the focus interrogative resumes.
Guilt or offense supplies the charge whose consequences cannot be escaped by changing direction.
Taking life supplies the irreversible act under examination and gives the question moral stakes.
A written sheet supplies durable evidence against which the hearers' trajectory can be tested.
Opening and spreading what branches out supplies public disclosure of the record.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness make what was done stand in the same forum as the questioned self.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ء د at 81:8 is used only as the grammatical patient of the passive question; no mapped root or branch is inferred for it.
The sequence moves from question to charge to exposed writing to each self knowing what it brought, before the focus asks where the plural audience goes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an examination, offense, killing, written evidence, disclosure, and presence. I infer that the later spatial question recasts departure as evasion from an assembled case. A live alternative is that the two interrogatives are rhetorically parallel without forming one forensic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Where will you travel after hearing the claim?
changed_reading.after: Where could you go to evade an examination whose victim, charge, record, and presented deeds are already before you?

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath sequence alternates recession, running, hiding, liminal darkness, and opening dawn. It changes going from a simple one-way line into a cycle of concealment and reappearance, allowing the focus question to ask whether the hearers' movement is progress or recoil from disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Going or passing supplies linear departure, which the oath sequence bends into retreat and return.
Receding into concealment or delay supplies recoil as one possible direction of going.
Flowing and running supply continuous motion between the phases of visibility.
The disappearance of stars into hiding places supplies motion whose endpoint is occultation.
Thin darkness at either edge of night supplies a reversible threshold rather than a terminal destination.
Dawn opening like breath supplies emergence as the counter-motion to hiding.

structural_cues: The oath orders hide, run, hide, night-edge, and dawn-opening before the claims about the message.
The paired thresholds make direction reversible: going away from light can be recession rather than advance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recession, flow, occultation, a two-edged night, and opening dawn. I infer an analogy between celestial visibility cycles and the audience's epistemic motion. A live alternative is that the oath authenticates the message without mapping its movement pattern onto the hearers.

changed_reading.before: Going is straightforward progress from one point to another.
changed_reading.after: Are you advancing, or merely recoiling into concealment at the very threshold where disclosure is opening?

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated qawl is first attributed to an honored messenger and then denied to a distant, deviant source; immediately after the focus it is recast as reminder. Because qawl itself has a belief-or-doctrine branch and the focus has a madhhab branch, 'where are you going' can ask which account the hearers are turning into a doctrine and way.

activation_trace.role: A route or manner called madhhab supplies the adopted interpretive way at issue.
Speech as belief or doctrine supplies the possibility that a received saying becomes an operative path.
The repeated doctrine-image marks the excluded attribution as a competing route rather than mere noise.
Distance and severance supply the relational direction of the rejected source.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the counter-route of recovered attention.

structural_cues: Two qawl attributions bracket ayna tadhhabuna on one side, while an exclusive reminder statement follows it on the other.
The focus therefore sits at the transition from source discrimination to adopted response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech-as-doctrine, an excluded source characterized by distance, the focus route-image, and reminder. I infer that source attribution becomes a choice of madhhab or operative stance. A live alternative is that qawl remains ordinary speech and the route language is only rhetorical.

changed_reading.before: The audience is asked where it will go after hearing a statement.
changed_reading.after: Which attributed saying are you converting into your belief, manner, and route, and how far does that route sever you from reminder?

context_deltas.mechanism: A second root contributes independent bewilderment, while the immediate pre-focus sequence supplies eye-or-insight, a horizon, and manifest disclosure. These cues rescue the strange focus dazzlement branch from isolation: the question can diagnose why the hearers lose orientation despite a plainly presented line of sight.

activation_trace.role: Dazzlement or fright upon seeing brilliance supplies the focus-root state of disturbed perception.
Bewilderment and confusion independently echo the focus dazzlement and make disorientation a cross-root activation.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the perceptual act whose orientation is contested.
Far horizons supply a visible directional boundary against which 'where' can measure deviation.
Appearance and disclosure make the horizon manifest, intensifying the puzzle of continued disorientation.

structural_cues: Explicit seeing at a manifest horizon occurs only three ayat before the focus orientation question.
The focus ayna can test perceptual bearings as naturally as geographic bearings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two branch-images of bewilderment, then seeing, horizon, and disclosure. I infer that the question exposes perceptual disorientation in the presence of a clear sightline. A live alternative is that the sea-root bewilderment branch is only a remote echo and the horizon solely authenticates the messenger's sight.

changed_reading.before: The odd dazzlement branch is an unsupported lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: What has dazzled or confused you into losing direction when sight, horizon, and disclosure have just been made explicit?

context_deltas.mechanism: The lines after the question supply a reminder, a branch-image of a distinguishing guide-mark, and straight alignment. This lets the post-focus context operate as a procedural answer: the question exposes lost orientation, then presents memory and a mark by which movement can be straightened.

activation_trace.role: The path or manner branch supplies the route that needs a waymarker and correction.
Bringing something back to presence after forgetfulness supplies restored orientation.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies a latent waymarker within the audience named immediately after the question.
Straightness, balance, and level alignment supply the corrected posture of movement.

structural_cues: Question, reminder, willing, and straightening form a consecutive 81:26-28 movement from disorientation to possible alignment.
The waymarker activation from 81:27 is branch-distant from the surface 'worlds' and is retained as an abductive cue, not a lexical substitution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, a guiding-mark branch, and straight alignment after the path-question. I infer that the next two ayat answer 'where' with an orientation practice rather than a named place. A live alternative is that the guiding-mark branch should not activate through the 'worlds' surface and only reminder plus straightness carry the model.

changed_reading.before: The question rebukes but supplies no navigational response.
changed_reading.after: Your route can be reoriented by recovered remembrance, a distinguishing mark, and the act of becoming straight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence translates going into willing-to-straighten, then nests that willing inside divine willing and lordship. Direction is therefore neither mechanical fate nor an autonomous destination choice: it is an enacted human orientation whose possibility and horizon are held by a larger agency.

activation_trace.role: Going supplies enacted direction, which the later will-language reveals as volitional without making it self-originating.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies the hearer's intentional pull toward an orientation.
Straightness and balance supply the normative shape toward which willing can direct movement.
The repeated willing-image supplies nested agencies and prevents the hearers' trajectory from being read as self-grounding.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the encompassing agency within which creaturely direction operates.

structural_cues: The second-person plural ending of tadhhabuna recurs in tasha'una, linking movement grammatically to willing.
The singular relative 'whoever wills' is followed by plural 'you do not will' and then divine willing, successively rescaling agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed willing, straight alignment, repeated human and divine will, and lordship. I infer that motion in 81:26 is the visible enactment of will, while 81:29 bounds rather than erases that enactment. A live alternative is to keep destination and volition as adjacent exhortations without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The plural audience autonomously selects and reaches a destination.
changed_reading.after: Your going discloses what you will toward, yet even the capacity to align that will is held within the Lord's willing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface verb conventionally activates departure, not economics. It remains valid as a cross-domain constellation anchored in the focus root's gold and measure branches and reinforced by packet branches for prized livestock, disuse, market price, a right-document, and valuation. Render it only as an exploratory value-audit resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same focus root that expresses going also carries branches for gold as precious material and dhahab as a measure.

activation_trace.role: Gold supplies the literal precious material and recasts direction as pursuit of a value-bearing object.
A named measure supplies the literal instrument by which the hearers' route and priorities can be assessed.
A she-camel at ten months of pregnancy supplies concentrated worldly value at the moment ordinary priorities collapse.
Vacancy, disuse, and disabling strip that valued asset of practical claim and reset the scale of worth.
Market price supplies an explicit pricing image inside the same sequence that ignites final consequences.
A document certifying a right supplies the ledger-like claim by which worth and obligation are made legible.
Valuation and pricing supply the final audit operation applied to the hearers' chosen direction.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily: what scale of value, price, and measure is carrying you when prized assets lose use and the reminder becomes the operative claim?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because gilding is a form-distant branch of the focus root rather than the ordinary sense of tadhhabuna. It remains anchored through that focus branch and a coherent packet sequence of ornament removed, cover stripped, and appearance disclosed. Render it as a material analogy about deceptive surface and orientation, explicitly qualified as exploratory, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory's gilding branch supplies an applied precious surface whose attraction can redirect the one who goes.

activation_trace.role: Gilding or gold overlay supplies the literal attractive surface and makes the route vulnerable to a merely applied sheen.
A neck left without jewelry or ornament supplies the removal of prestige-bearing decoration.
Removing a cover and revealing the hidden supplies the material action that defeats an overlay.
Appearance and disclosure supply the clear surface against which gilded semblance can be distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns movement through external space.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily: which applied brilliance are you following when ornament, covering, and hiddenness are being stripped into disclosure?

strongest_changes: The destination question becomes an orientation crisis because its cosmic and terrestrial coordinate system has been folded, scattered, moved, and stripped.
Going becomes forensic evasion once questioning, guilt, killing, records, disclosure, and presented deeds form an assembled case.
The focus becomes a hinge from source discrimination to doctrinal route, then from reminder and waymark to straight alignment.
Post-focus repetition links plural going to plural willing while preserving the larger bound of divine willing and lordship.
A coexisting social reading treats movement as convergence and self-sorting into companions defined by likeness and deed.
summary.what_was_special: The single focus root opened several non-collapsible mechanisms: literal departure, adopted manner, dazzled perception, value and measure, and gilded surface. Context did not select one winner; it made departure spatial, forensic, social, epistemic, volitional, and materially evaluative at once, with the branch-distant activations explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The dazzlement model is strengthened by a cross-root bewilderment echo, but that sea-root branch may remain too distant from the contextual surface to bear more than exploratory weight.
The guiding-mark activation at the 'worlds' occurrence is structurally productive but form-distant; reminder and straightness support the model even if that cue is ablated.
The orbital concealment analogy may describe the oath's signs without transferring their movement pattern to the audience.
The value/measure and gilded-surface outliers are coherent branch constellations, not claims about the verse's ordinary lexical translation.
